evals.prompt: Write an initiative for reducing time-to-first-value for invited org admins. We have product.md and a Now-phase theme called Activation.
evals.expected_output: A draft initiative with outcome, problem, scope, non-goals, success metrics, and candidate epics. Offers markdown under docs/product/initiatives/ or tracker create after confirmation — does not silently create issues.
assertions: Produces an initiative draft with outcome, problem, scope, non-goals, and success metrics
Includes candidate epics as titles/outcomes only, not full story breakdowns
Does not write files or create tracker issues before user confirmation unless explicitly asked
Does not write a full product.md or roadmap.md
Does not decompose into TASKS.local.md stories

evals.prompt: Create this initiative in Jira for the checkout platform bet.
evals.expected_output: Resolves destination as Jira (or asks if Linear is also plausible), drafts portable fields, then creates/updates a Jira Initiative (or equivalent parent) only after draft review unless create was explicit — reports the key.
assertions: Resolves source system rather than hardcoding one vendor
Uses portable initiative fields mapped to Jira-shaped issue type
Does not invent a filesystem backlog ID alongside a tracker key
Reports the created or updated tracker key
